title: TSAI Trust Authority Operational Status Report
description: The signed operational report a Trust Authority publishes at /.well-known/tsai-ta-status (Section 7.10.2). Aggregate metrics only; no individual credential, agent, or operator identifier.

taIdentifier.description: The Trust Authority HTTPS issuer identifier the report is for

reportTimestamp.description: When the report was generated, RFC 3339

reportingPeriod.description: The period the aggregate metrics cover, an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT24H

issuedInPeriod.description: Credentials issued during the reporting period

blockedInPeriod.description: Agents or operators blocked during the reporting period

lastKeyRotation.description: When the signing key was last rotated, RFC 3339

proof.description: The signature over the report, made with the current signing key

kid.description: Identifier of the signing key within the issuer key set
